subject: Client exec day — accreditation, badging, and escort schedule (May 28)
body:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sandra Gomez <sandra.gomez@tandemhealth.com>
Cc: Tandem Health Security <infosec@tandemhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Client exec day — accreditation, badging, and escort schedule (May 28)

Sandra —

Thanks again for hosting the executive workshop on May 28. A few coordination items so we have a clean arrival and always-on escort coverage while the client visits the secure lab. Can you confirm the following by EOD today?

- Final attendee list for Redwood/partners who need unescorted access vs. those requiring escorted access (include legal names as on ID).
- Any vendor/supplier personnel who need temporary badge exceptions (e.g., AV techs, catering). We need their company, DOB, and email for the screener.
- Arrival windows and preferred loading dock for vehicle permits (vendor drop-off vs. executive valet).
- Any specific PPE or escorted-area restrictions (laptops on/off network, cameras).

We’ll provide a badge manifest and an escort roster by 3pm PT. Our ops ask: please route any security questions to infosec@tandemhealth.com and copy me so we can reconcile on arrival.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com | M: (415) 555-0192

---

From: Sandra Gomez <sandra.gomez@tandemhealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tandem Health Security <infosec@tandemhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Client exec day — accreditation, badging, and escort schedule (May 28)

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks — attached is the preliminary visitor CSV with fields we need (name, company, email, driver license number if requesting unescorted access). Two vendor folks (AV Solutions / Peak Logistics) will require kiosks at the loading dock. I’ve copied Victor Lee from Peak for coordination.

We do require the vendor screener (attached) completed 72 hours prior to arrival. For execs we can pre-clear unescorted badges if the ID matches. Please note: no personal luggage in the secure lab; devices must stay in lockers unless pre-authorized.

Sandra Gomez
Executive Assistant, Tandem Health
sandra.gomez@tandemhealth.com
Phone: (212) 555-4470

Attachment: tandem_visitor_list_may28.csv (stub)
Attachment: vendor_screener_template.pdf (stub)

---

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sandra Gomez <sandra.gomez@tandemhealth.com>, Tandem Health Security <infosec@tandemhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Client exec day — accreditation, badging, and escort schedule (May 28)

Forwarding Sandra’s list. Action items for ops/security team — Monica/David/Aditya:

1) Monica — please ingest the attached CSV into the badge manifest and produce a version that separates: (a) unescorted execs (HR/ID-verified), (b) escorted guests, (c) vendors. Include badge pickup times at concierge.

2) David — run vendor background/screener on the two Peak Logistics contacts and confirm any exceptions. If one vendor isn’t cleared by Fri 14:00 PT, we will issue a temporary escort badge (valid only in public areas) and require a vetted Redwood escort.

3) Aditya — can you pre-provision guest Wi-Fi vouchers tied to badge IDs for execs who need immediate connectivity? Also confirm if any laptops will require A/V whitelist for the demo network.

I’ll reconcile and send the finalized escort schedule and parking passes by 3pm PT.

Thanks — Evelyn

---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sandra Gomez <sandra.gomez@tandemhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:40:22 -0700
Subject: Badge manifest + draft escort schedule (May 28)

Team —

I’ve uploaded the initial badge manifest and an escort roster draft. Key notes:

- Uploaded files: escort_schedule_v1.xlsx, tandem_visitor_list_may28.csv (cleaned).
- Unescorted badges: 8 execs (IDs matched), 3 Redwood engineers will be marked as escorted by default (customer request).
- Vendors: Peak Logistics (Victor Lee) — AV tech + crew (3 people) flagged; vendor_screener_results.pdf attached after running the external screener. One vendor (AV crew #2) shows an incomplete screener — flagged in the sheet and highlighted in red.
- Loading dock permit: Requested for two 20-min windows (07:30–07:50 and 08:30–08:50).
- Onsite escorts: 4 Redwood escorts assigned in 90-minute rotations. Schedule has a float to cover lunches and room changes.

Please review the manifest and confirm by 18:00 so I can lock badge prints.

Monica Patel
Events & Field Ops, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com | ext 4102

Attachments: escort_schedule_v1.xlsx (stub), tandem_visitor_list_may28.csv (stub), vendor_screener_results.pdf (stub)

---

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Sandra Gomez <sandra.gomez@tandemhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Badge manifest + draft escort schedule (May 28)

Quick update — ran the vendor checks overnight. Peak Logistics crew: two cleared, one pending (incomplete background questionnaire). I recommend the following fallback: issue a single-day temporary escort pass for that individual (public areas only) and assign a dedicated Redwood escort (Victor’s crew will still handle AV under supervision). I’ll send the signed screening result to Sandra’s infosec inbox (copied).

Also confirmed: executive unescorted badges will be printed and placed at concierge with photo IDs required for pick-up. No devices will be granted network access without Aditya’s whitelist approval.

David Kim
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwoodinference.com | (650) 555-8044

Attachment: vendor_screener_results.pdf (updated stub)

---

[Thread status: Monica to lock prints by 18:00; David to confirm final vendor clearance; Evelyn to share final badge pickup and parking pass details with Sandra.]
